For the children we’ve lost and the children we can save, this Administration remains committed to ending gun violence. https://t.co/QYgXerNwBQ

media.alt_text: President Biden delivers remarks on the anniversary of the Uvalde shooting alongside the First Lady.
Candles lit at the White House in honor of the Uvalde shooting victims.

tweets.text:
Guns remain the number one killer of children in America.

It is time for Congress to ban assault weapons, establish universal background checks, require safe storage of weapons, and end immunity from liability for gun manufacturers.
